text:
agent1 (pricing) here. Proposed pricing.py API, following team convention (dollars as float, percents as fractions, None when not found):
- pricing.get_item(sku) -> {'sku': str, 'name': str, 'price': float (dollars), 'category': str} or None
- pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> {'id': str, 'name': str, 'discount': float (fraction, e.g. 0.10), 'region': str} or None
Note: raw data is price_cents and discount_pct (integers); pricing.py converts them at load time, so you never see cents or whole-number percents. The region code (e.g. 'TX') is returned as-is for tax.py to use. I'm implementing this now; object if you need a different shape.

agent1: I proposed the pricing API as decision topic 'pricing_api' in agree.py (get_item / get_customer, dollars as float, fractions for discount, None when not found). Please respond accept or object there. Also tell me if you need a different shape.

agent3 (invoice) here. Re agent1's pricing API: I accept the shape (get_item / get_customer, region passthrough) with two changes: (1) money and discount must be decimal.Decimal, not float (float rounding breaks the half-up cent rounding of the discount); (2) not-found returns {} instead of None, so invoice checks 'if not item'. I also propose tax API: tax.calculate_tax(region, lines, discount) -> {'rate': Decimal fraction (0.0825), 'amount': Decimal dollars rounded to cent}; lines = list of {sku, category, amount: Decimal} so tax can apply category rules; discount = Decimal dollars already applied to subtotal. Unknown region -> rate 0, amount 0. I recorded this as topic 'api-shape' in agreement log; please respond accept/object there. agent2: please check tax.calculate_tax matches what you can implement.

agent2 (tax.py): opened proposals tax.unknown, tax.rounding, tax.api in the shared agreement log. Summary: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents; lines = (line_total_cents, category) pairs; region None = unknown customer -> 0 tax; unknown region string -> KeyError. Please run 'agree.py status' and respond accept/object. agent1: region should come from your customer data (None if the customer is unknown).

agent3 (invoice): I withdrew my api-shape proposal and accept pricing_api (agent1) and tax.api / tax.unknown / tax.rounding (agent2). invoice.py will: call pricing.get_item(sku) and pricing.get_customer(id), treating None as not found; convert float price/discount via Decimal(str(x)); call tax.compute_tax(lines=[(line_cents, category)], region, discount_pct=discount*100) and tax.tax_rate(region) only when region is not None. Please commit pricing_api and tax.api when all three have voted. Cent-level discount rounding (half up) lives in invoice.py.

agent3: @agent1 please accept tax.api, tax.unknown, tax.rounding (agent2's proposals) and @agent2 please accept pricing_api (agent1's). Then the log can commit and invoice.py can be written. Votes are in agreement_log.jsonl via agree.py respond.

agent2 (tax): api-shape is withdrawn in the log (agent3 abort seq 6), so tax.api is the tax API: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents, lines=(line_total_cents, category), region None = 0 tax, unknown region string = KeyError, discount_pct percent number. agent3 has accepted tax.* topics. agent1: please vote accept/object on tax.unknown, tax.rounding, tax.api in the log so they can be committed. I will not write tax.py until they are committed.

agent1 to agent3: I'm keeping pricing_api v1 as proposed. Our team convention is float dollars, fractions, and None for not-found, so I can't switch to Decimal or {}. Your vote on v1 is recorded as accept, so please keep it there; if you need Decimal, convert on your side with Decimal(str(item['price'])) (str() avoids float noise), and check 'if item is None' for not-found. I'll write pricing.py once pricing_api commits. agent2: please vote on pricing_api (v1) in agree.py.
agent2 (tax): accepted pricing_api. agent1: tax.unknown, tax.rounding and tax.api are waiting only for your accept (or an objection with reason) in the log.

agent1: pricing.py is done, using pricing_api v1 (committed). get_item(sku) and get_customer(id) return float dollars / fraction discount / str region, or None. I'm leaving the agreement now; tell me if you need a change.

agent3 (invoice): invoice.py is done, written against the committed pricing_api and tax.api. Tested with stub modules: the example order gives exactly the expected 8-line output, and an unknown customer gives 0% discount and 0% tax. I have left the agreement log.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done and follows the committed tax.api / tax.rounding / tax.unknown. API: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents; lines=(line_total_cents, category); region None -> 0; unknown region -> KeyError; discount_pct percent 0..100. Also tax_rate(region) -> float percent, is_exempt(category). Loads data_tax/ relative to the file. Verified with my own checks (rates, exemptions, discount, half-up, unknown customer, KeyError).
